data.name: Gentilis
data.gender_notes: Gentilis is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'gentilis', meaning 'born in a family' or 'kind'. This name was given to those who were not Roman citizens, but were kind and hospitable to Romans. It is a reminder of the importance of being welcoming and gracious to all people. The name Gentilis carries the meaning “Kind stranger, hospitable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gentilis usually hope their child will grow to embody kind stranger, hospitable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace hospitality and kindness, opening your heart to all.
data.etymology: Gentilis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind stranger, hospitable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gentilis total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
